answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the atlas count is verified against the mirror text itself, the vertex audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 60 aliases therefore means producing 60 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
